race.description: The Agency Real Estate Mdn Plate
race.comment: SNITZEL'S GIRL (10) is the most experienced runner in the field and looks ready to break through. Stepped up to this distance for the first time last start and as even through the line after settling off the speed. Draws a better gate this time and against moderate opposition she gets her chance. DARN SURE (4) has filled a placing and been beaten just over a length in his two runs to date, the latest over 1400m at Warwick Farm. Bright prospects. CADMEAN (3) came from last to get up for second in an eye-catching effort over 1450m at the Illawarra Grange circuit recently. Harder this time but the extra 100m is a tick. Market watch on Ciaron Maher's first starters I REALLY THINK SO (5) and BAVARIA (1). The former won a recent Warwick Farm trial impressively and has been more impressive than his stablemate on the track, but the market has BAVARIA ahead.
